description: Liste des stations de recharge électrique voitures sur le territoire de la Communauté de Communes ADOUR MADIRAN is a dataset listed in portail Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Communauté de communes Adour Madiran. Cette liste présente les stations de recharge électriques du territoire avec le descriptif donné par le Syndicat Départemental d' Electricité. Coverage: Hautes-Pyrénées. The portal files it under Routes / Transports. The portal shows 10 records. The portal shows 2022-06-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-ha-py-fr-portal.
